alu.source:
li   x1, 0x12345678
    li   x2, -7
    add  x3, x1, x2
    sub  x4, x1, x2
    and  x5, x1, x2
    or   x6, x1, x2
    xor  x7, x1, x2
    sll  x8, x1, x2          # shift by -7 & 31 = 25
    srl  x9, x2, x1
    sra  x10, x2, x1
    slt  x11, x2, x1
    sltu x12, x2, x1
    addi x13, x1, -2048
    slti x14, x2, -6
    sltiu x15, x2, 1
    xori x16, x1, -1
    ori  x17, x2, 0x7ff
    andi x18, x1, 0x0f0
    slli x19, x1, 31
    srli x20, x2, 28
    srai x21, x2, 1
    lui  x22, 0xfffff
    auipc x23, 0x1
    addi x0, x1, 1           # writes to x0 are discarded
    add  x24, x0, x0
    li   a0, 0

    li   t6, 0x300000FC
    sw   a0, 0(t6)
spin: j spin

branches.source:
li   s0, 0               # accumulates a checksum of taken paths
    li   t0, 5
loop:                         # count down: BNE taken 4 times
    addi s0, s0, 3
    addi t0, t0, -1
    bne  t0, x0, loop
    li   t1, -1
    li   t2, 1
    blt  t1, t2, l1          # signed: taken
    addi s0, s0, 100
l1: bltu t1, t2, bad         # unsigned: not taken
    bge  t2, t1, l2          # taken
    addi s0, s0, 100
l2: bgeu t1, t2, l3          # taken
    addi s0, s0, 100
l3: beq  t1, t1, l4
    addi s0, s0, 100
l4: call sub                 # JAL ra
    addi s0, s0, 1
    la   t3, sub2
    jalr ra, 0(t3)
    la   t4, odd_target
    jalr x0, 1(t4)           # target LSB cleared by JALR
bad:
    li   a0, 1

    li   t6, 0x300000FC
    sw   a0, 0(t6)
spin: j spin

sub:  addi s0, s0, 7
      ret
sub2: addi s0, s0, 11
      jr   ra
odd_target:
      addi a0, s0, -34      # expected checksum: 5*3 + 7 + 1 + 11 = 34

    li   t6, 0x300000FC
    sw   a0, 0(t6)
spin2: j spin2

loadstore.source:
li   s1, 0x10000100      # DMEM
    li   t0, 0x89ABCDEF
    sw   t0, 0(s1)
    lw   t1, 0(s1)
    lb   t2, 0(s1)
    lb   t3, 1(s1)
    lb   t4, 3(s1)
    lbu  t5, 3(s1)
    lh   t6, 0(s1)
    lh   a1, 2(s1)
    lhu  a2, 2(s1)
    sb   x0, 1(s1)
    lw   a3, 0(s1)
    li   t0, 0x55
    sb   t0, 3(s1)
    sh   t0, 4(s1)
    lw   a4, 0(s1)
    lw   a5, 4(s1)
    addi a6, a5, 1           # load-use: depends on the load just before
    lw   a7, -4(s1)          # negative offset
    sw   a6, 8(s1)
    lw   s2, 8(s1)
    add  s3, s2, s2          # load-use again
    li   a0, 0

    li   t6, 0x300000FC
    sw   a0, 0(t6)
spin: j spin

sum_array.source:
li   s1, 0x10000000
    li   t0, 0
    li   t1, 64
fill:                         # mem[i] = i * 3
    slli t2, t0, 2
    add  t2, t2, s1
    add  t3, t0, t0
    add  t3, t3, t0
    sw   t3, 0(t2)
    addi t0, t0, 1
    blt  t0, t1, fill
    li   t0, 0
    li   a0, 0
sum:
    slli t2, t0, 2
    add  t2, t2, s1
    lw   t3, 0(t2)
    add  a0, a0, t3
    addi t0, t0, 1
    blt  t0, t1, sum
    li   t0, 6048            # sum is 3 * 64*63/2 = 6048
    sub  a0, a0, t0          # -> exit code 0

    li   t6, 0x300000FC
    sw   a0, 0(t6)
spin: j spin

trap_illegal.source:
li a0, 1
    .word 0xffffffff

    li   t6, 0x300000FC
    sw   a0, 0(t6)
spin: j spin

trap_ecall.source:
li a0, 1
    ecall

    li   t6, 0x300000FC
    sw   a0, 0(t6)
spin: j spin

trap_misaligned_lw.source:
li s1, 0x10000002
    lw a0, 0(s1)

    li   t6, 0x300000FC
    sw   a0, 0(t6)
spin: j spin

trap_misaligned_sh.source:
li s1, 0x10000001
    sh a0, 0(s1)

    li   t6, 0x300000FC
    sw   a0, 0(t6)
spin: j spin

trap_misaligned_jump.source:
li t0, 0x102
    jalr x0, 0(t0)

    li   t6, 0x300000FC
    sw   a0, 0(t6)
spin: j spin

trap_misaligned_branch.source:
beq x0, x0, 6

    li   t6, 0x300000FC
    sw   a0, 0(t6)
spin: j spin
